title: Impact of Dataset Properties on Membership Inference Vulnerability of Deep Transfer Learning
findings: This paper has no findings related to religion. The key finding is that the vulnerability of fine-tuned models to Membership Inference Attacks decreases according to a power law as the number of examples per class increases.
